map.为什么格式化后键的顺序变了？: Why did the key order change after formatting?
map.TOML 要求「表必须位于所有普通键之后」，格式化器会把根级标量提到前面、再按层: TOML requires "tables must come after all plain keys"; the formatter moves root-level scalars to the front and orders table headers by hierarchy, so the order appears reordered. This is a format constraint, not data loss. If you need a fixed human-readable order, organize by hierarchy in the source, or mark sections with comments.
